Class Animal

game.actors.Animal
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable, Feedable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Chicken, Cow
public abstract class Animal extends WanderingActor implements Feedable
Abstract base class for farm animals that wander randomly around the map and can be fed. Subclasses need only define their heal amount and the item(s) produced when fed.
